name: pf-plan-generosity-farm
about: plan-generosity-farm against the built packages classes, specs, town instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Pelor's favour, the Paladin of Generosity's crop trait in mods/farming (plan_generosity bot, section farm): with a Generosity paladin in the party the wild plot chance a run floor rolls is twice farm.run_chance (35 -> 70, hwp farm chance), and a counted run (hwp farm grow) grows an unwatered cabbage by 2, ready after one run instead of two.
